name: claude-desktop
description: The Claude host profile: it binds the delivery engine's six host slots to Claude's own files, paths, and capabilities — repo-instructions to CLAUDE.md, repo-flow-context to .claude/flow-context.md, model-override to the personal flow model-selection file, stage-delegation to sub-agents, surface to delivery-dashboard, pr-lane to the gh CLI — and ships the two procedures that belong to the host rather than to the engine: start, which brings the repository's own application up and opens it, and session-handoff, which packages a session into a brief the next one continues from. Declares no dependency: the flows themselves live in delivery, and a binding nothing reads is inert.
